recipe.visualDefinition: A centered, thin-bordered rectangular photograph of two men standing in a coastal landscape at dusk, set against a larger, textured indigo-purple background featuring a faint circular ring and centered serif typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Inner framed photograph nested within a larger textured border
Horizontal horizon line in photo contrasting with vertical orientation of the layout
Typography positioned in the upper third, bridging the gap between the frame and the top edge
Figures positioned in the lower right quadrant of the inner frame for asymmetrical balance
coreInvariants: Thin white border around the central image
Faded circular ring texture on the outer background
Dusk lighting with orange and purple gradients

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Two figures occupy the bottom right of the inner frame, scaled to approximately one-third of the frame height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central rectangular frame acts as the primary geometric anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye starts at the centered text, moves down to the bright sunset horizon, and settles on the two figures in the foreground.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Substantial negative space in the upper two-thirds of the inner frame (sky) and the outer indigo border.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep indigo-purple (outer border and sky shadows)
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Warm orange and pale pink (sunset horizon)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low-value, high-saturation purple background contrasts with the high-value, low-saturation white elements.

letterConstructionRules: High stroke contrast between thick and thin lines
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface used for all display elements to maintain 80s minimalist formality.
graphicDevices: Faded ring texture (simulating ring wear on a vinyl sleeve)

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the sharp serifs and high contrast of the original.
Provides the standard classical serif look typical of the era.
Offers a similar traditional weight and elegance.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a deep indigo square background with a faint, distressed white circular ring texture. In the center, place a horizontal rectangular photograph with a thin white border. The photo should depict two men in sweaters and white trousers standing on a coastline during a purple and orange sunset.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add centered uppercase text in a white high-contrast serif font above the inner frame. Use wide letter spacing.

verificationChecks: Is the text centered and uppercase?
Is there a thin white border around the inner photo?
Does the background have a subtle circular distress mark?
Are the figures placed in the lower right of the inner frame?

adjustableVariables: Opacity of the circular ring texture
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the figures
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the inner frame is perfectly centered horizontally.
Verify the indigo background has a matte, slightly textured feel.
Check that the white text is sharp and high-contrast against the purple.
Confirm the sunset gradient is smooth without banding.
recipe.reuseFormula: Centered Frame + Indigo Border + High-Contrast Serif + Wide Tracking + Sunset Photography
